description: This file is a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb) designed for currency exchange rate forecasting using multiple models, including ARIMA, SARIMAX, Exponential Smoothing, and LSTM neural networks. It contains code, markdowns explaining the workflow, data fetching, preprocessing, model training, and prediction results related to forecasting EUR/USD exchange rates utilizing OpenBB and yfinance data.
